```python
import griffe

# Load the requests package using the module-level convenience entry point
module = griffe.load("requests")

# Get all public top-level functions
functions = []
for name, member in module.members.items():
    if not name.startswith("_") and isinstance(member, griffe.Function):
        functions.append(name)

# Print sorted list
for func_name in sorted(functions):
    print(func_name)
```
